name: airk
displayName: AIRK — Artifact Indexing and Retrieval Kernel, the Local MCP Power Tool for Coding Agents
description: Give Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot and other MCP agents a local index of your workspace that returns bounded, cited evidence. No cloud service, API key or Docker. Beta.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: AIRK starts its native helper and reads workspace files only after you trust the workspace. Until then it registers no MCP servers and refuses indexing, setup and maintenance commands.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with AIRK
walkthroughs.description: Index this workspace locally and give Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot or another MCP agent cited evidence from it.

steps.title: Index this workspace
steps.description:
AIRK runs only in trusted workspaces. If this folder is not trusted yet, use [Manage Workspace Trust](command:workbench.trust.manage). Then build the local collection:
[Index Now](command:airk.index)
The AIRK status-bar item shows measured coverage when the scan finishes. Indexes use per-user storage by default; to put them on another drive, [Choose Index Storage Folder](command:airk.chooseStorage) first.

media.altText: Saved files become a published index before an agent retrieves evidence.

steps.title: Choose when to index
steps.description:
By default AIRK updates the index a few seconds after file changes settle, which also catches edits made by coding agents. Switch to When idle, On save or Manual if you prefer.
[Choose Indexing Mode](command:airk.indexMode)

media.altText: Edits are batched into a new published index revision.

steps.title: Connect a coding agent
steps.description:
VS Code and Copilot Chat discover AIRK automatically; enable it with **MCP: List Servers**. For other clients, preview the selected folder's configuration and merge it into that client's settings. Open AIRK in the Extensions view and read **Details → Coding agent setup** for complete instructions for every supported client. Antigravity uses the gemini preview but its own mcp_config.json location. Amazon Q and Windsurf/Devin receive connection details to enter in their own UI. AIRK never edits another agent's settings.
[Set Up Coding Agent](command:airk.setupAgent)

media.altText: Several coding agents connect to the same workspace-scoped AIRK collection.

steps.title: Verify the connection
steps.description:
Check that the native helper starts, lists its tools and reports collection status. Then ask your agent about a file you know and confirm that its answer cites a path.
[Verify Native MCP Connection](command:airk.verifyMcp)

media.altText: An agent retrieves bounded evidence from a published local collection.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Index once file changes have been quiet for `#airk.index.quietMs#`. Catches edits made by coding agents and other tools, not just this editor.
Wait until file changes have settled **and** the editor has had no typing or selection activity for `#airk.index.idleMs#`. Fewest interruptions; slowest to update.
Index documents you save in this editor. Changes made outside VS Code, for example by a coding agent, wait for **AIRK: Index Now**.
Never index automatically. Use **AIRK: Index Now** from the status-bar controls or the Command Palette.
airk.index.mode.markdownDescription: When AIRK updates the index automatically. In every mode, **Index Now**, **Set Up Coding Agent**, **Verify Native MCP Connection** and an agent's first connection to an unindexed folder still index explicitly. Pausing auto-indexing overrides this setting until you resume.

airk.index.quietMs.markdownDescription: Milliseconds without new file changes before an automatic batch starts. Lower values index sooner but may start in the middle of a multi-file change; raise this if a coding agent that writes many files triggers repeated small batches. Not used in **Manual** mode.

airk.index.idleMs.markdownDescription: **When idle** mode only. Milliseconds without editor activity (typing or moving the selection) before indexing starts; the quiet period `#airk.index.quietMs#` must also have passed. Idle mode never uses `#airk.index.maxDelayMs#` to start a batch while you are active.

airk.index.maxDelayMs.markdownDescription: **After edits settle** and **On save** modes. The longest a continuous stream of changes can postpone a batch, so a folder that a coding agent edits non-stop is still indexed at least this often. Still subject to `#airk.index.minIntervalMs#`, pause state and the storage budget.

airk.index.minIntervalMs.markdownDescription: Minimum milliseconds between the end of one automatic indexing job for a folder and the start of the next. Jobs run one at a time in each VS Code window. Raise this on slow disks or for large collections. Manual **Index Now** is not delayed.

airk.storage.path.markdownDescription:
Absolute folder for index data on **this machine**. Empty uses VS Code's per-user extension storage. AIRK reads only your user setting; workspace settings cannot redirect storage. Prefer **AIRK: Choose Index Storage Folder…**, which rejects a folder that is, or contains, an open workspace folder.

Changing this builds new indexes at the new location. Existing indexes stay where they were and remain available in **Manage Collections and Disk Space**. Restart agents that are already connected so they use the new location.

airk.storage.maxBytes.markdownDescription:
Soft limit, in bytes, on all index data in the current storage folder. `0` turns the limit off. Source files and the helper cache are not counted. Example: `2147483648` is 2 GiB.

When usage reaches the limit, automatic indexing stops and the status bar shows **Storage budget**. **Index Now** still runs and can exceed the limit. Nothing is deleted automatically: reclaim space with **Trim Obsolete Index Generations…** or **Remove Unneeded Collection…**, or raise the limit, then run **Resume Auto-indexing**.
